lines.zh: 我一寸一寸地挪，壳刮着石头。
lines.en: I inch along, my shell scraping the stone.

lines.zh: 浪推我一下，我就挪了半格。
lines.en: A wave shoves me, and I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 我不追谁，只等谁来。
lines.en: I chase no one; I just wait for someone to come.

lines.zh: 石头缝里走，最安全。
lines.en: Moving through cracks in the rock is safest.

lines.zh: 我的脚粘在地上，抬起来很费劲。
lines.en: My foot is glued down; lifting it is hard.

lines.zh: 潮退了，我得往低处挪。
lines.en: The tide went out; I must move lower.

lines.zh: 壳太重，我走得比蜗牛还慢。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; I am slower than a snail.

lines.zh: 沙子在壳底下磨，沙沙响。
lines.en: Sand grinds under my shell with a hiss.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石边挪，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I creep along the reef edge, where food is.

lines.zh: 挪到水深处，我就停下来。
lines.en: Once in deeper water, I stop.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下一小片湿痕。
lines.en: Every step leaves a small wet mark.

lines.zh: 挪不动的时候，我就等潮水。
lines.en: When I cannot move, I wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 我把壳闭上，世界就黑了。
lines.en: I close my shell, and the world goes dark.

lines.zh: 水从壳缝里慢慢流过。
lines.en: Water seeps through the gap in my shell.

lines.zh: 我用触手捞水里的碎屑。
lines.en: I sweep scraps from the water with my tentacles.

lines.zh: 潮声一下一下，我跟着数。
lines.en: The tide sounds again and again; I count along.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长了一层绿苔。
lines.en: A layer of green moss grows on my shell.

lines.zh: 鱼从我旁边过，不看我一眼。
lines.en: Fish pass by and never glance at me.

lines.zh: 我贴在石头上，像石头的一部分。
lines.en: I cling to the rock like part of it.

lines.zh: 水冷了，我的触手缩回去。
lines.en: The water cools, and my tentacles pull back.

lines.zh: 我听得见船底划过头顶。
lines.en: I hear a boat keel pass overhead.

lines.zh: 壳里很闷，但我习惯了。
lines.en: It is stuffy inside the shell, but I am used to it.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹在我壳上敲。
lines.en: A little crab taps on my shell.

lines.zh: 我张一下壳，又合上。
lines.en: I open my shell a crack, then shut it.

lines.zh: 退潮时我会干一会儿。
lines.en: At low tide I dry out for a while.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，等水再来。
lines.en: I do nothing and wait for the water to return.

lines.zh: 我张开壳，尝了尝水。
lines.en: I open up and taste the water.

lines.zh: 一只海星爬过我的左边。
lines.en: A starfish crawls past my left side.

lines.zh: 水退了，我听见沙在响。
lines.en: The tide left. I hear the sand hiss.

lines.zh: 我在等下一次涨潮。
lines.en: I am waiting for the next high tide.

lines.zh: 你站在礁石上，影子投下来。
lines.en: You stand on the reef, your shadow falling down.

lines.zh: 你的靴子会踩碎我的壳。
lines.en: Your boots could crack my shell.

lines.zh: 你潜下来了，我看见了。
lines.en: You dove down; I saw you.

lines.zh: 你在敲石头，我有点怕。
lines.en: You are knocking on the stone, and it frightens me.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来了，我缩回去。
lines.en: Your hand comes near, so I pull back in.

lines.zh: 你带着船上的焦油味。
lines.en: You carry the tar smell of a boat.

lines.zh: 你吐的泡泡，一个个往上跑。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise one by one.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我也一直看着你。
lines.en: You watch me, and I keep watching you too.

lines.zh: 你手里有刀，我不出来。
lines.en: You hold a blade; I am not coming out.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的邻居了。
lines.en: You stepped on my neighbor.

lines.zh: 你在水里很笨，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are clumsy in water; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你走远一点，我才敢张嘴。
lines.en: Move further away, and only then will I open.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道缝，水灌进来。
lines.en: A crack splits my shell, and water seeps in.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把壳闭得更紧。
lines.en: I make no sound; I only clamp my shell tighter.

lines.zh: 你砍在壳上，震得我发麻。
lines.en: Your blade rings on my shell and numbs me.

lines.zh: 我还撑得住，别急。
lines.en: I can still hold on; do not hurry.

lines.zh: 我的触手断了一根，缩回去了。
lines.en: One tentacle snapped off; I pulled it back.

lines.zh: 壳口被你踢掉一块，我缩回去。
lines.en: You kicked a chip off my shell's mouth; I withdraw.

lines.zh: 石头被我抓出了印子。
lines.en: My grip has left a mark on the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下让我松开了脚。
lines.en: That blow loosened my foot.

lines.zh: 我把身子缩到最里面。
lines.en: I pull myself as far inside as possible.

lines.zh: 你等着，潮水会帮我。
lines.en: Wait; the tide will help me.

lines.zh: 你撒的碎屑，顺着水飘过来了。
lines.en: The scraps you scattered drift over to me.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: When the current shifts, I know food is coming.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔下来，我不客气。
lines.en: Drop a fish down, and I will take it gladly.

lines.zh: 水里有腥味，我张开壳。
lines.en: There is a fishy smell; I open my shell.

lines.zh: 你晃着那只桶，里面是什么？
lines.en: You sway that bucket; what is inside it?

lines.zh: 我等着潮水把吃的送来。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to bring my food.

lines.zh: 你靠近一点，我就多张一分壳。
lines.en: Come a bit closer, and I open a bit wider.

lines.zh: 我不追，吃的得自己来。
lines.en: I do not chase; food must come to me.

lines.zh: 那只死鱼卡在石头缝里了。
lines.en: That dead fish is stuck in the rock crack.

lines.zh: 有光的地方，小虫会来。
lines.en: Little things come where there is light.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的壳，脚趾会疼。
lines.en: Kick my shell, and your toe will hurt.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，撞上来更疼。
lines.en: I do not move, so bumping me hurts more.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的剑会打滑。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your sword will slide off it.

lines.zh: 你踩住我了，我缩得更深。
lines.en: You stepped on me; I sink even deeper.

lines.zh: 别推，我一挪就离开石头了。
lines.en: Do not push; one shove and I leave my rock.

lines.zh: 船底刮过我，掉了一些碎片。
lines.en: A boat keel scraped me and left some chips.

lines.zh: 我的壳挤着你的脚踝。
lines.en: My shell presses against your ankle.

lines.zh: 你把我翻过来，我张着嘴。
lines.en: You flipped me over, and my shell hangs open.

lines.zh: 撞一下，水都浑了。
lines.en: One bump, and the water clouds up.

lines.zh: 我挡在洞口，你过不去。
lines.en: I block the hole; you cannot get through.

lines.zh: 我把卵撒进水流里。
lines.en: I release my eggs into the current.

lines.zh: 它们会漂很久，才找到石头。
lines.en: They drift a long way before finding stone.

lines.zh: 旁边那只也张开了壳。
lines.en: The one beside me opens its shell too.

lines.zh: 水暖的时候，我们才一起放。
lines.en: We spawn together only when the water warms.

lines.zh: 成千上万的小点，随潮走了。
lines.en: Thousands of tiny specks ride the tide away.

lines.zh: 我看不见它们，只能等。
lines.en: I cannot see them; I can only wait.

lines.zh: 壳挨着壳，水从中间过。
lines.en: Shell against shell, water flows between us.

lines.zh: 有几只会回来，长在石头上。
lines.en: A few will come back and grow on this rock.

lines.zh: 我们把下一代交给海。
lines.en: We give the next generation to the sea.

lines.zh: 我老了，它们才刚开始。
lines.en: I am old, and they have only just begun.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷住一片海草。
lines.en: I curl a tentacle around a piece of kelp.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳掉在我旁边，我收下。
lines.en: This shell fell beside me; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我用触手把石子拨开。
lines.en: I brush a pebble aside with my tentacles.

lines.zh: 有块骨头卡进缝里，我抓住它。
lines.en: A bone wedged in the crack; I grasp it.

lines.zh: 东西太滑，我卷了三次才卷住。
lines.en: It is so slippery I needed three tries to hold it.

lines.zh: 我把亮片贴在壳边。
lines.en: I press a shiny bit against my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 我捡不了太重的东西，会脱手。
lines.en: I cannot hold heavy things; they slip free.

lines.zh: 一只海星爬过来，我推回去。
lines.en: A starfish creeps near; I push it back.

lines.zh: 这根海带缠住我了。
lines.en: This strand of kelp has tangled around me.

lines.zh: 我把船钉收进壳缝里。
lines.en: I tuck a boat nail into my shell's gap.

lines.zh: 你进到我的范围了。
lines.en: You have entered my range.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道有东西。
lines.en: The water stirs, and I know something is here.

lines.zh: 我先合上壳，等你靠近。
lines.en: I shut my shell first and wait for you to come near.

lines.zh: 你的脚就在我上面。
lines.en: Your foot is right above me.

lines.zh: 我不出声，壳就是石头。
lines.en: I make no sound; my shell is just stone.

lines.zh: 你踩在礁石上，震得我发麻。
lines.en: You step on the reef, and the tremor numbs me.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳靠近。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat coming closer.

lines.zh: 触手在壳里慢慢伸开。
lines.en: My tentacles slowly unfurl inside the shell.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰了，正好。
lines.en: You are bending down; perfect.

lines.zh: 有东西碰到我的边缘。
lines.en: Something has touched my rim.

lines.zh: 我等着，等到你脚踝露出来。
lines.en: I wait until your ankle is exposed.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，壳就开一条缝。
lines.en: When you reach in, my shell opens a crack.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手腕的位置。
lines.en: I fix on the spot of your wrist.

lines.zh: 你摸石头，我就跟着你的手。
lines.en: You feel the rock, and I follow your hand.

lines.zh: 水花的动静，比你的脚步准。
lines.en: The water's ripple is truer than your steps.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张壳，不让你看见。
lines.en: I open slowly so you do not notice.

lines.zh: 你绕开这边，我就再等。
lines.en: You skirt this side, so I wait again.

lines.zh: 我的触手在壳口等你。
lines.en: My tentacles wait at the shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我不追。
lines.en: You backed two steps; I do not chase.

lines.zh: 只要你在礁石上，就跑不掉。
lines.en: As long as you stand on the reef, you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 触手一缠，勒住你的脚踝。
lines.en: A tentacle lashes out and binds your ankle.

lines.zh: 我从壳里弹出，速度很快。
lines.en: I snap out of the shell, fast.

lines.zh: 你被拖向礁石缝。
lines.en: You are dragged toward the rock crack.

lines.zh: 力道不大，可你甩不掉。
lines.en: The grip is not strong, but you cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 我的壳边缘很利。
lines.en: The rim of my shell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的手腕，你握不住刀。
lines.en: I coil around your wrist, and you cannot hold the blade.

lines.zh: 触手带着黏液，滑不掉。
lines.en: The tentacles are slimy and will not slip off.

lines.zh: 你一抬脚，我立刻缩回壳。
lines.en: You lift your foot, and I retract at once.

lines.zh: 我在你腿上留下一圈红印。
lines.en: I leave a red ring on your leg.

lines.zh: 你以为我是石头，这就是代价。
lines.en: You thought I was a rock; that is the price.

lines.zh: 我在礁石上睁开壳。
lines.en: I open my shell on the reef.

lines.zh: 水流把我送到这里，我就留下。
lines.en: The current brought me here, and I stayed.

lines.zh: 小时候我还会游，现在不会了。
lines.en: As a larva I could swim; now I cannot.

lines.zh: 我选了一块背光的石头。
lines.en: I chose a stone away from the light.

lines.zh: 壳一点点变硬，颜色也深了。
lines.en: My shell hardens bit by bit and darkens.

lines.zh: 潮水退去，我第一次看见天空。
lines.en: The tide went out, and I first saw the sky.

lines.zh: 旁边已经有两只老的。
lines.en: Two old ones were already beside me.

lines.zh: 我把脚粘死在这块礁石上。
lines.en: I glue my foot fast to this reef.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是漂过的碎屑。
lines.en: My first meal was drifting scraps.

lines.zh: 有鱼想咬我，壳已经硬了。
lines.en: A fish tried to bite me; the shell was hard.

lines.zh: 我不知道海有多大。
lines.en: I do not know how big the sea is.

lines.zh: 我落下的那天，水里全是泡沫。
lines.en: On the day I settled, the water was all foam.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我壳都软了。
lines.en: Hot water softens my shell.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上被撬下来，往下掉。
lines.en: Pried off the reef, I fall.

lines.zh: 水太深，我张不开壳。
lines.en: The water is too deep; I cannot open my shell.

lines.zh: 爆炸震碎了我身边的石头。
lines.en: The blast shattered the stone around me.

lines.zh: 箭射进壳缝，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow lodged in my shell's gap and stuck.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我触手打卷。
lines.en: Potion light makes my tentacles curl up.

lines.zh: 水太清，一点碎屑都没有。
lines.en: The water is too clear; not a scrap of food.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，水里全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea, and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 礁石不见了，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: The reef is gone, and I keep sinking.
